title: Understanding Principal Component Matrix
text: The principal component matrix $P$ is derived from the original matrix $X$ using singular value decomposition (SVD).

title: Decomposing the Principal Component Matrix
text: When decomposing $P$ into its principal components, we use the formula $P=U_P*Sigma_P*V_P**T$.

title: Understanding $V_P**T$
text: In the context of PCA, $V_P**T$ represents the rotation matrix that aligns the principal components with the original axes.
